details.description: Lyria 3 Clip Preview is a Google DeepMind music generation model, offered through the Gemini API, optimized for short musical clips, loops, and previews. It generates 30 seconds of high-quality, 48kHz stereo audio from text prompts or image inputs. Released March 25, 2026, it remains in preview status; Google's Gemini API deprecations page recommends migrating to the newer Lyria 3.5, which now covers both short clips and full-length songs.
advantages: Generates 30 seconds of high-quality, 48kHz stereo audio from text or image prompts (Gemini API model page).
Accepts image inputs in addition to text prompts (Gemini API model page).
disadvantages: In preview status; Google's Gemini API deprecations page lists lyria-3.5 as the recommended replacement (Gemini API deprecations page).
Limited to 30 seconds of output audio, versus full-length songs on the newer Lyria 3.5 (Gemini API model page).
use_cases: Generating short musical clips, loops, and previews from text prompts
Generating short musical clips from image inputs

notes: Catalog facts list kind 'chat', endpoints /v1/chat/completions and /v1/completions, and modality audio_output/text_input, but Google documents this as a music-generation model that also accepts image input and returns lyrics text alongside audio; kept the catalog's facts as authoritative and described the model's real capabilities instead. Catalog's max_input_tokens (131072) matches the Gemini API model page's stated input token limit; max_output_tokens (8192) is not stated on the source pages. Google's pricing page groups this model under a 'Lyria 3' heading described in body text as 'Google's family of legacy music generation models' (not literally titled 'Lyria 3 (Legacy)'), even though the deprecations page lists no shutdown date, so the pricing page's 'legacy' language and the deprecations page's active-preview status appear to disagree; both are noted here rather than picking one for the description.
